source: authenticated original fusion source V2 custody loader; unchanged
population: complete three selected original VALID splits; 6123 nodes/predictor/split
scoring: raw FP32 logit argmax for single/members; arithmetic mean FP32 probabilities for four-member native predictor
accuracy_decomposition: shared-independent = difference in mean member accuracy + difference in pooling gain over mean member accuracy

output_tables: all classes/members/pairs/degree bins; explicit support/numerator/denominator/null degeneracies
hull_oracle: separate source-only design; not implemented/executed here
interpretation_guardrails: README.md fixed pattern-to-hypothesis table; no causal sharing collapse or information absence inference
